subject: Weekly MAP sync: implementation playbook, eval rubric & attendee stitching
messages:
From: Rajiv Desai <rajiv.desai@acme-corp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emily Park <emily.park@acme-corp.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / weekly sync for implementation playbook

Hi Monica —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Emily and I pulled together what we think should be the weekly MAP checkpoints so we can keep the evaluation and procurement tracks aligned. Proposed: a 30-minute weekly sync focused on checklist status (environment prep, dataset handoff, eval rubric results), owners, and any blockers to the close timeline.

Two quick asks:
- Can you confirm Redwood owners for (a) infra readiness, (b) eval run execution, (c) contract redline owner?
- Any constraints for Tuesday mornings PST — Emily is in PST, I’m IST next week for a customer visit.

Attaching a one-page scope (see attachment stub). If Tuesdays don’t work we can propose Wed/Thu.

Thanks,
Rajiv Desai
Head of Data & Integrations, Acme Corp
attachments: scope_onepager.pdf (attachment)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Desai <rajiv.desai@acme-corp.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T08:06:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / weekly sync for implementation playbook

Rajiv —

Appreciate the proposed cadence. Short answers up front:
- Infra readiness owner: Rishi Malhotra (I’ll copy him below to confirm schedule windows).
- Eval run execution owner: Karthik Iyer (will help define the rubric and run cadence).
- Contract redline owner: Stephanie Nguyen (she’s on legal/enterprise deals; I’ve looped her separately in the thread).

Notes on timing: Tue mornings PST are tight for our EMEA & APAC folks on other accounts. For the next two weeks I can do Tue 10:00–10:30 PT, but after that we should consider a rotating hold or alternate times so Rajiv/Emily aren’t excluded when Rajiv travels.

Proposed agenda for the 30m weekly:
1) 3m quick status cadence (green/amber/red) on MAP milestones
2) 10m evaluation results & next test run owners
3) 10m open blockers + action owners and deadlines
4) 7m procurement/contract updates and next steps

I attached a draft playbook (REDWOOD_MAP_playbook_v3.xlsx) with owner columns — please review, mark owner changes in the sheet. I’ll send a calendar hold for Tue 10:00 PT for the next two weeks and include a rotating option after that.

Action: Rishi, confirm infra window options. Karthik, confirm eval-run cadence (weekly vs. biweekly) and whether you need additional Redwood compute for parallel runs.

— Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | monica.patel@redwood.ai
attachments: REDWOOD_MAP_playbook_v3.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Desai <rajiv.desai@acme-corp.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-23T12:44:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / weekly sync for implementation playbook

Monica / Rajiv —

Confirming infra windows:
- Preferred: Tue 10:00–10:30 PT (for the next two weeks only) — allows us to do a quick infra smoke before the eval run scheduled Tue afternoon.
- Longer-term: recommend we move to Wed 08:00 PT every other week (this avoids APAC overnight and gives us time to collate eval metrics).

On compute: for parallel eval runs (to compare quantization and latency profiles) I’ll request an extra 1 GPU slot per run for Karthik’s team; this is feasible but requires us to mark the runs in the playbook so we can pre-warm the cache.

Action items (from my side):
- I’ll add an \"infra_window\" column in the playbook and mark the pre-warm requirement.
- I’ll share an infra smoke checklist in the Drive link before Tue.

Quick note for Rajiv: if you’ll be IST-heavy next week, Tue 10:00 PT = Wed 00:30 IST — that’s late for you. If you can delegate attendance to Emily on those specific weeks, the sync still works.

— Rishi Malhotra
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
attachments: calendar-hold.ics (attachment)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Desai <rajiv.desai@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-25T15:03:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff / weekly sync for implementation playbook

All —

Quick confirm: I’m planning weekly eval runs for the first three weeks (Tuesday afternoon runs as Rishi suggested). The evaluation_rubric_v2.pdf I’m attaching has the agreed metrics (accuracy thresholds, latency ceilings, and sample set definitions).

Owners for the first two sprints:
- Eval orchestration & run: Karthik Iyer (redwood)
- Dataset handoff and labeling clarifications: Rajiv Desai (acme) / Emily Park (acme)
- Infra pre-warm & monitoring: Rishi Malhotra (redwood)
- Contract negotiation touchpoint: Stephanie Nguyen (redwood legal)

If everyone’s good I’ll mark these owners in the playbook and finalize the calendar invite Monica is sending. If Rajiv needs to push due to travel, Emily can be primary on the sync and Rajiv will join the post-run readout.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Model Ops & Evaluation, Redwood Inference
attachments: evaluation_rubric_v2.pdf
